task: Extend T01's working Expo Go app to 25 other K-line strategy apps: sync shared modules, implement 26 strategy logics, verify all compile
loop_altitude_rationale: Sequential gated stages (infra to strategy to verify), single-agent, all changes reversible in git. No parallel fan-out needed — mechanical file operations + code generation.

selection_log.why: runnable check exists: npx tsc --noEmit per app (fast, <5s, exit 0 = done). Done is machine-decidable.
infra_sync produces correct file structure, consumed by strategy_impl; strategy_impl produces valid strategy.ts, consumed by final_verify; each seam is a stable checkable artifact (tsc pass).
infra_sync is mechanical copy (retry on file errors); strategy_impl is code generation needing mid-flight correction (plan_execute_verify); final_verify is a correctness review pass.
blast=LOW (isolated app dirs), reversibility=HIGH (git), feedback=HIGH (tsc). Human reviews at gates, not each iteration.
stages are strictly sequential; within each stage, 26 apps processed in single-agent pass. No independent fan-out work.
infra_sync cap=3 (file errors escalate); strategy_impl cap=8 (allows per-app retry, loops back to infra if shared modules wrong); final_verify cap=3 (loops back to strategy on regression).
context rebuild across 26 apps is expensive; tsc check is fast but running it 26x per pass is the bottleneck. Few long thorough passes beat many short ones.

definition_of_done.goal: All 26 app directories have identical src/shared/ (9 .ts files), screens/ (3 files), App.tsx, types/index.ts, theme/colors.ts matching T01 versions. Each app compiles with npx tsc --noEmit.

feedback_signal.check: powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem -Path 'F:\opencode\Single metric\kline-strategy-apps' -Directory -Filter 'app-*' | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne 'app-template' } | ForEach-Object { $d=$_.FullName; $ok=$true; @('src\shared\indicators\Indicators.ts','src\shared\database\SQLiteProvider.tsx','src\shared\services\KlineFetcher.ts','src\shared\services\StockInfoFetcher.ts','src\shared\services\SyncService.ts','src\shared\components\KlineChart.tsx','src\shared\components\SyncPanel.tsx','src\shared\theme\colors.ts','src\screens\HomeScreen.tsx','src\screens\DetailScreen.tsx','src\screens\SettingsScreen.tsx','src\App.tsx','src\types\index.ts') | ForEach-Object { if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $d $_))) { Write-Host "MISSING: $($_) in $($_.Name)"; $ok=$false } }; if ($ok) { Write-Host "OK: $($_.Name)" } else { Write-Host "FAIL: $($_.Name)" } }"
feedback_signal.falsifiable_when: any app is missing src/shared/Indicators.ts, src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx, or other key files — the check lists MISSING: for each
